assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape featured cover artwork for Village of Shadows, a playable multi-agent AI Werewolf learning game. Create a breathtaking premium 3D miniature nocturnal village on a floating rugged island. Seven distinct empty chairs arranged around a circular glowing council table in the foreground, slender cyan threads connecting six glass lantern-like agent totems to the table, one unlit human chair. Behind them, a cluster of timber houses, one tall watchtower, pine trees and mist, with a subtle distant wolf silhouette among the trees. A large pale blue moon. Convey hidden knowledge, discussion and human participation in an interconnected AI system. No gore, no combat. Materials: sapphire glass, silver, weathered dark timber, cold blue stone. Palette exclusively midnight navy, deep cobalt, steel blue, cyan and icy moonlight. No purple, violet, magenta or pink. Meticulous architectural diorama with cinematic atmospheric perspective, restrained glowing blue network paths, tactile physically based materials. Wide landscape 3:2 composition with the council circle in lower foreground and village rising behind it, comfortable negative space around edges. No words, letters, logos, badges, watermark or screenshot UI. Illustrative project art, not a screenshot.
